items.title: Frank Capp interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Well it’s a pleasure, Monk, thanks for inviting me.

ctx.x: Good afternoon. We’re filming here today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a great pleasure to be here with Frank Capp, who seems to be one of the busiest drummers on the West Coast from the description he just gave us of his upcoming weekend with the L.A. Classic Jazz Fest. And thanks, Frank, for coming in and squeezing in some time with us.
Well it’s a pleasure, Monk, thanks for inviting me.
Did this kind of popularity kind of come overnight for you?
